cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(WeftCore LANGUAGES C CXX)
  set(WEFT_CORE_SDK "" CACHE PATH "Use an already built native Weft SDK for this host")
  if(WEFT_CORE_SDK)
    foreach(component lib/libweft_compiler.so lib/libweft_runtime.so include/weft/compiler.h include/weft/runtime.h)
      if(NOT EXISTS "${WEFT_CORE_SDK}/${component}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "WEFT_CORE_SDK is missing ${component}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
    if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "WEFT_CORE_SDK packages an SDK already built for the native host")
    endif()
    include(CheckCSourceRuns)
    set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES "${WEFT_CORE_SDK}/lib/libweft_compiler.so")
    check_c_source_runs("extern unsigned weft_compiler_abi(void); int main(void) { return weft_compiler_abi() != 1; }"
      WEFT_CORE_SDK_EXECUTABLE)
    unset(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES)
    if(NOT WEFT_CORE_SDK_EXECUTABLE)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "WEFT_CORE_SDK must execute on this host with compiler ABI 1")
    endif()
    set(WEFT_SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
    set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
    if(NOT DEFINED WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT)
      set(WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT weft_core)
    endif()
    install(DIRECTORY "${WEFT_CORE_SDK}/" DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT} USE_SOURCE_PERMISSIONS
      PATTERN "__pycache__" EXCLUDE PATTERN "_runtime*.so" EXCLUDE)
    add_subdirectory(python)
    return()
  endif()
  find_package(LLVM REQUIRED CONFIG)
  find_package(MLIR REQUIRED CONFIG)
  list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${LLVM_CMAKE_DIR}" "${MLIR_CMAKE_DIR}")
  include(TableGen)
  include(AddLLVM)
  include(AddMLIR)
  include_directories(SYSTEM ${LLVM_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${MLIR_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  if(LLVM_ENABLE_ASSERTIONS)
    add_compile_options(-UNDEBUG)
  endif()
  set(WEFT_STANDALONE ON)
endif()

# The embedding compiler and standalone SDK select the same LLVM/MLIR build.
set(WEFT_SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(WEFT_BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
if(NOT DEFINED WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT)
  if(WEFT_STANDALONE)
    set(WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT .)
  else()
    set(WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT triton/_C/weft)
  endif()
endif()
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
if(NOT LLVM_ENABLE_RTTI)
  add_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-rtti>)
endif()
include_directories(${WEFT_SOURCE_DIR}/include ${WEFT_BINARY_DIR}/include
  ${WEFT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime/include)
if(NOT TRITON_WEFT_RUNTIME_ONLY)
  add_subdirectory(include)
endif()
add_subdirectory(lib)
if(NOT TRITON_WEFT_RUNTIME_ONLY)
  add_subdirectory(lib/Compiler)
endif()
option(WEFT_BUILD_PYTHON "Build the shared Python native-launch binding" ${WEFT_STANDALONE})
if(WEFT_BUILD_PYTHON)
  add_subdirectory(python)
endif()
if(NOT TRITON_WEFT_RUNTIME_ONLY)
  target_include_directories(WeftRISCVTarget PUBLIC
    ${WEFT_SOURCE_DIR}/include ${WEFT_BINARY_DIR}/include)
endif()
install(TARGETS WeftRuntime LIBRARY DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/lib)
install(FILES runtime/include/weft/runtime.h runtime/include/weft/runtime.hpp
  DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/include/weft)
install(DIRECTORY integrations/llama.cpp/ DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/share/llama.cpp)
install(FILES cmake/WeftConfig.cmake DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/lib/cmake/Weft)
install(FILES LICENSE NOTICE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
  DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/licenses)
install(FILES lib/Runtime/ggml-threadpool-LICENSE
  DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/licenses)
install(DIRECTORY licenses/ DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/licenses)

include(cmake/NativeToolchain.cmake)
